Hi Alexandra & Samir,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions about latency and multi-tenant isolation. As promised, I’ve attached the demo recording and the slide deck we used. Quick notes:

- Deck page 7 shows the Dedicated vs Hosted throughput assumptions we discussed.
- I’ve flagged the security/compliance callouts (page 12) for your security team.

If it’s helpful, Monica (cc’d) can join a short 15-minute Q&A to walk through any technical questions or to confirm the performance numbers against your expected traffic pattern. I’m free next week on Tue/Wed mornings (10–12 PT) and Thu 2–4 PT. Book a slot here if any of those work: https://cal.com/jordan-blake/15
